svg.desc: A random walk of the z-statistic of an A/A test over 14 days crosses the 1.96 line on day 5 and ends near zero on day 14. A sequential boundary starts high and narrows. False-positive rates: 0.05 for one look, about 0.20 for daily peeking, 0.02 with Bonferroni, 0.05 with a sequential boundary.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Peeking: every look is another chance for noise

svg.text: One A/A test (no true effect), z-statistic recomputed every day for 14 days.
